title: Packers to honor Bob Harlan's memory by installing his name on the Lambeau facade

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Packers to honor Bob Harlan's memory by installing his name on the Lambeau facade
sources.description: The Packers will honor the memory of Bob Harlan, announcing Tuesday that they will install the name of the team's former president and CEO on Lambeau Field's northeast facade.
